name: EnglishPath
campus: Secure your academic success in the heart of Queensland with our elite 10-week IELTS Exam Preparation program. At our modern Brisbane campus, this course is designed for students at an Upper Intermediate level (B2/IELTS 5.0+) who are ready to prepare for the IELTS exam with absolute precision. Whether you are aiming for higher education in Australia or global career registration, our program provides the essential university preparation and strategic edge needed to conquer the IELTS test.

In our General English One-to-One course, we use a communicative approach, building confidence while giving plenty of opportunities to use the new language skills you acquire. You will receive homework to do before your next session and lessons will be tailored to your needs and learning preferences.
